title: Exact Integer Range Materialization v1
objective: Preallocate and fill trusted built-in exact integer ranges for Sage ellipsis and list(range(...)) while preserving generic Python iteration fallbacks, reducing one-million-entry materialization below 80 ms with comprehensive conformance tests

handoff.summary: Added checked runtime primitives for preallocated exact-integer range materialization and lazy native exact-range iteration, routed built-in range iteration through the native iterator, and accelerated the common one- and two-start Sage ellipsis forms while retaining the existing generic fallback. CPython-differential tests cover iterator identity, next, exhaustion, fallback, repeated and nested iteration, and exact Number/BigInt transitions; Sage tests cover inclusive and descending ellipses, zero steps, oversized materialization, symbolic/rational/float fallbacks, richer prefixes, and iterator overrides. On this host [1..10^6] fell from about 538 ms to 6.57 ms median and list(range(1, 10^6 + 1)) measured 42.19 ms, both below the 80 ms gate. Build and compiler receipts pass; integration passed 256/258 tests and failed only because the shared native-boundary inventory intentionally remains for the integration lane.
risks: The runtime type stub and reviewed native-boundary inventory are shared integration surfaces outside this lane and do not yet declare the two new intrinsics.
The focused test is run directly on this branch because the shared Node test manifest is owned by the concurrent FFLAS lane.

Sage ellipsis materialization briefly owns a raw preallocated array and its decorated-list copy; the observed one-million-entry path remains small and fast, but substantially larger lists retain ordinary JavaScript allocation limits.
next_steps: Add exact_integer_range_values and exact_integer_range_iterator signatures to src/baselib/sagejs/runtime.pyi.
Regenerate and review architecture/native-boundaries.json for runtime:exact_integer_range_values and runtime:exact_integer_range_iterator.
Register test/exact-integer-range-v1.cjs in test/node-test-manifest.cjs after the FFLAS lane releases that file.
Rerun strict baselib, architecture, and integration gates, record the passing integration receipt, then set this task to review or complete in the integration branch.
